Resolves #21509

The examples group list stops showing a borrowed count in parentheses. Trees and Drag & Drop own no examples, so under #21130's rule (home records only) their entries now show no number, and the footnote that explained the parentheses goes. The live filter from #21496 follows the same rule for a group whose matches are all borrowed. `ExampleGroup.countLabel` still names what a group borrows, in words: in each entry's `aria-label` and on the group's page.

Evidence: L2 (the unit and e2e specs run in CI; before/after frames below) → L2 required (AC-1 to AC-3 are rendered state the specs drive; AC-4 is the frames).

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI: `MainContainerController.spec.mjs`: the index numbers are the home counts, empty for Trees and Drag & Drop, and the index holds the all-examples link, the unbanded list and the five bands, with no note. `ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs`: no count contains a parenthesis, and under the filter "drag", Drag & Drop (all matches borrowed) shows no number. |
| AC-2 | CI: `MainContainerController.spec.mjs`, each entry without a number has an `aria-label` ending "from other groups" |
| AC-3 | CI: `ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs`, the headline equals the sum of the list's numbers, in the production build and in Dev mode |
| AC-4 | Frames under Test Evidence |
